en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a dense urban neighborhood with rows of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century multi‑story buildings featuring ornate facades and gabled roofs. In the foreground is a prominent, elaborate residential or commercial block facing a tree‑lined street, labeled as the Nürnbergerhaus at the Lendkai area of Graz. The background shows tightly packed houses and apartment buildings typical of a Central European city.
